class.name: franka_trajectory_replay/TrajectoryReplayController
class.description: Replays a joint trajectory on an FR3, in position mode (robot-internal joint impedance) or effort mode (example joint impedance law), and publishes reference vs measured at 1 kHz.

class.name: franka_trajectory_replay/CartesianTrajectoryReplayController
class.description: Replays a Cartesian pose trajectory on an FR3 with the torque law of Franka's CartesianImpedanceExampleController, and publishes reference vs measured at 1 kHz.
